title: Building browser based FPS game using Claude (HATS CORP)
author: Exotic_Cash_142
selftext:
Latest release: [https://whatever-games.itch.io/selling-hats-corp](https://whatever-games.itch.io/selling-hats-corp)

I'm working on the demo now. So this is what I think about the state of making games with AI. 

  
1. Storytelling is still a spot for human input. The machine is really bad in writing stories and dialogues. If you ask it to write a dialogue, it will come out cringy and overpacked with text with no meaning. As if the amount of words in the line somehow should make it better. But the art of writing is say a lot with less. 

[Intro cinematic](https://preview.redd.it/w4jxrsg9nljh1.png?width=2534&format=png&auto=webp&s=a20c556e9119ffb27cab7b7fbaf5ec2ab7961eac)

2. 3D geometry generation is not the best, but good enough for demos. I have almost 20 weapons in the game and most of them inspired by Quake. Claude made really simple models for them at first, which worked for early demo. Then I decided that we need to have them a bit more detailed. So it made them detailed, but with that came the FPS drop cause it made them from tons of small geometry shapes, which in total had huge polygon count. 



https://preview.redd.it/afyvsnonnljh1.png?width=2548&format=png&auto=webp&s=68866ccf03d738134dddee3d20cbf76e1f834d30

3. Debug is not the best experience if you don't know what to look for. So I have low FPS and I need to figure out why. Even with the fact that I have some prior experience with gamedev, it is kind of challenging to debug the game and you can't rely much on AI cause it will think half a day and then give you some wrong explanation of what is going on.  

https://preview.redd.it/tr5junwwnljh1.png?width=2544&format=png&auto=webp&s=037e1f9a97e287e1bb4f467652cd832eafbed588

  
But besides of that, I really enjoy making a game with it. The stuff that used to have a learning curve now is reachable, so it is good for creative process I think. At the same time I miss the collaboration factor, so if anybody wants to collab on this game, I'm open to it. It is a hobby project with zero budget, no plans for the commercial launch or something for now. 

And I decided to change the name to HATS CORP.
